units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:27">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ההן דש׳ תומא</he> he that grinds garlic. Ib. 10ᵇ bot.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 146a:8">B. Bath. 146ᵃ</cite> <he>שַׁחְקֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="M02526"><he>מַרְגְּנִיתָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Midr. Sam. ch. I, v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>שְׁחִיק</he>.—<he>ש׳ טמיא</he>, v. <cite ref="I00545"><he>טַמְיָא</he></cite>; (in Hebr. dict.) <he>ש׳ עצמות</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, beg.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:2">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוות רגליה שחקה</he> (read: <cite ref="U00655"><he>שְׁחִיקָא</he></cite>) his foot was sore from rubbing.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:2">Y. Dem. II, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>שחיקא</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:1">Dem. II, 1</cite>), v. <cite ref="U00697"><he>שָׁחַק</he></cite>

senses.gloss: to mention the name of a dead person with the imprecation שחיק טמיא (his bones be ground), to curse.
units: Lev. R. s. 32, end מדכרין ומְשַׁחְקִין there are those whose names are mentioned with a curse, opp. ומניחין, v. נוּחַ h.; Yalk. Ex. 411 (Hebr.) מזכירין ומְשַׁחֲקִים; Tanḥ. Vayaḳhel 4; Ex. R. s. 48 (mixed dict.) מדכרין ומשחקים; Midr. Sam. ch. I ושָׁחְקִין (Pe.).
